title: SAP NetWeaver (Internet Graphics Service) does not sufficiently validate certain input values within… (CVE-2026-109807)
description: SAP NetWeaver Internet Graphics Service has a vulnerability where it does not sufficiently validate certain input values in incoming requests. An unauthenticated attacker can send specially crafted requests that cause the affected process to read beyond declared values, leading to repeated termination of the worker process. This results in a high impact on availability but does not affect confidentiality or integrity.
